variables.title: CPU-saturation investigation
variables.log_evidence: The highlighted logs come from ${truth.finding} itself: request queueing aligned with CPU peak. A second signal now lines up with the metric, so the CPU saturation matches the slowdown.

demonstration.narration: I'll open this host's Logs tab to see whether the slowdown happened during the CPU peak.
demonstration.reasoning: A resource spike alone does not prove customer impact or causation. Matching its entity and timing to another observable signal tests the relationship.
